Digit reader

Draw one digit, 0 to 9. A small neural network (256 inputs, two hidden layers of 256 and 128 units, 10 outputs) runs in this page and guesses what you wrote.

?

Draw something to begin.

The 16×16 image the network actually sees

Trained on the MNIST dataset (70,000 MNIST handwriting samples, plus rotated, sheared and thickened copies). Accuracy on held-out samples: 98.4%. Thick, centered strokes work best; it can still be fooled by unusual styles.
